notes.title: Guide on Resolving Game Launch Issues.
notes.content:
[b]June 13, 2024 Update:[/b]

Today, we have updated the runtime libraries related to game execution (VC Redistributable Packages). If any users who installed the game before the 13th are experiencing issues where the microphone works but voice recognition does not function properly during oath-taking, please try uninstalling and reinstalling the game.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hello magical girls!

First of all, we apologize to the magical girls who have experienced inconvenience related to game launch issues.

Here are some solutions to common issues that may occur when launching Steam games.

0. Check if the microphone is connected to the PC. For Windows 10, go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and ensure 'Allow apps to access the microphone.' For Windows 11, go to Privacy & security > Microphone and make sure 'Microphone access' is turned 'On.' Also, verify that the microphone permissions are granted for the game.
[url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/turn-on-app-permissions-for-your-microphone-in-windows-10-94991183-f69d-b4cf-4679-c98ca45f577a]Microsoft Support[/url]


1. Change the installation path of Steam and the game If the folder path where the game is installed is too long, it may cause loading issues. Try installing the game in a folder with a shorter path. https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=7418-YUBN-8129


2. Run Steam Client as an administrator Try running the Steam Client as an administrator. Right-click on the Steam Client on the desktop or in the program list and select "Run as administrator."

3. Antivirus program flags Steam games as problematic Sometimes, antivirus programs mistakenly identify certain files as viruses and delete them. Temporarily disable your antivirus program, reinstall the game, and then try running it again. https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=4361-MVDP-3638


4. Verify the integrity of game files If some of the necessary game files are missing or have been altered, it may cause issues. Verify the integrity of the game files. https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2037-QEUH-3335


5. Clear the download cache If the download cache is corrupted, it may cause issues with game installation. Clear the download cache and try reinstalling the game. https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=3134-TIAL-4638


6. Update your graphics drivers Sometimes issues with game launch can be caused by outdated graphics drivers. Update to the latest or most stable graphics drivers using your graphics card software (NVIDIA GeForce Experience, AMD Adrenalin, etc.).


If you still experience issues after trying the above methods, please send detailed information (CPU, GPU details, Windows version, etc.) to cs@relugames.com to help us identify the problem.

Thank you.

notes.title: Grand Magical Bureau Report Episode 3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Grand Magical Bureau Report Episode 3[/b][/h1]
The third story in the series prepared by the Magical Bureau! This episode's protagonist is Paul, who once dreamed of becoming the best caregiver but unfortunately fell into malevolence.

[h3][b]Dreaming of Becoming the Best Caregiver[/b][/h3]
Not much is known about Paul in depth, but she often spoke to Jeomrye about her hometown. From stories of vast deserts and the Silk Road, we can roughly guess her birthplace.
Paul came to Korea in 2010, and due to her long stay, she speaks fluent Korean. While looking for work, she saw a job posting recruiting caregivers exclusively for elderly individuals and became an elderly caregiver. Due to her meticulous and personable nature, she adapted well and helped many elderly people. Because the job suited her so well, she often said she aimed to become the best caregiver. However, contrary to her seemingly ordinary persona...

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/d1d1fe3dd8c64fe75ae8cd42384d2977831cc453.png[/img]
[Profile Picture of Paul]

[h3][b]The Truth of the Incident[/b][/h3]
Though Paul took good care of many elderly people, shockingly, her true feelings were not as they seemed, and her friendly smile was revealed to be a facade to the whole world. We conducted a detailed investigation to uncover the full story of this incident.

Firstly, Paul, who always took care of Jumrye’s medication, saw Jumrye struggling to swallow bitter herbal medicine. Instead of the medicine, she gave Jumrye a large amount of aspartame. Paul didn't provide a reason for this action and merely stated it was for Jumrye, who couldn’t take the bitter medicine. 
After Paul's arrest, a search of her home revealed an unusually large amount of aspartame, and interviews with acquaintances indicated that she was in the habit of adding aspartame to all her food. The investigation team concluded that Paul was an extreme aspartame addict, to the point where she abandoned common sense for an unending sweet taste. Considering the harmful effects of sugar on the elderly, the investigation team added that it might not have been the worst decision.

Secondly, Paul did not deny the allegations of using the magical girls' pension accounts for personal gain. The investigation confirmed this through an examination of the transaction history. However, Paul claimed not to remember due to the purification effect. The investigation team reported that the incident involved misappropriating heating costs in the summer, returning the account to Jumrye, and using the final amount for aspartame to maintain her figure, concluding the investigation.

Thus, it was acknowledged that Paul's wrongdoing was due to a mind tainted with malevolence, and she will face appropriate consequences.

[h3][b]The Heroic Acts of Manager Kim and Meow*[/b][/h3]

Paul's malevolence did not last long as it was eventually discovered by the righteous agent, Meow*. notes.title: Introduction to Magical Mic Duel with Friends
notes.content:
Hello, Magical Girls! ✧⁺⸜(･ ᗜ ･ )⸝⁺✧

We appreciate the interest and support from all our magical girls and magical girl candidates. We hope you enjoy training to become a magical girl through the game!

In "Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear My Spell", you can engage in magical duels with friends. To help you enjoy these duels more smoothly and elegantly, we've prepared a guide!

[h3][b]Magic Wand (Microphone) Setup[/b][/h3]

It's essential to make sure your magic wand is working correctly for magical duels. Please refer to the existing guide for details: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2696400/view/6398004206837291500


[h1][b]MAGIC DUELS[/b][/h1]

Magical duels are a test of a magical girl's qualities. To help you focus more on your spells and get familiar with the duel methods, we provide the following instructions.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/a4af48c94973d5ab734580cd51071303b6d263d5.jpg[/img]

You can choose from two types of magical duels:

[b]Local Multiplayer[/b]: Two players can duel using the same computer and one microphone.
[b]Online[/b]: Get a room number and duel with friends over the network.
Both local and online modes must be conducted in the same language.



[h1][b]Local Multiplayer[/b][/h1]

This mode allows dueling on the same computer with one microphone.

[b]Controls[/b]

The left character moves the cursor with [b]WASD keys[/b] and selects with the [b]Space key[/b].
The right character moves the cursor with [b]arrow keys[/b] and selects with the [b]Enter key[/b].


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/860f0239b1ccd65f559d45571371c0159ca30d61.jpg[/img]
[b]Character Selection[/b]

Choose your desired character.


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/dd5c12c2a7f66f3ad3ffd4fd56a1166f0356fb69.jpg[/img]
[b]Location Selection[/b]

Each magical girl selects a preferred location, and one of the two chosen locations will be randomly decided.



[h1][b]Online Duels
[/b][/h1]

If you need to duel with a magical girl who is far away, you can use the network for your duel.

[b]<For the Magical Girl Creating a Room>[/b]

The magical girl creating the room should click "Create Online Game" to generate a duel code. Share this code with the magical girl you want to duel using a messenger, text, Discord, telepathy, etc.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/bd0e439ee4e8c3416671a0ca615c0133c5ede0e2.jpg[/img]


[b]<For the Magical Girl Joining a Room>[/b]

The magical girl joining the room should click "Join Online Game" and enter the received code in the prompt to connect.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/e436bbeca6996e7e2700190656cda1c1e007ac62.jpg[/img]

After entering, select your character and location as you would in a local duel but by clicking with mouse.




[h1][b]Duel Rules[/b][/h1]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/e3e090e7f8c357a9140bfd916bf0347342258749.jpg[/img]

[b]Duel Declaration[/b]

Follow the instructions from Meow*, and get ready for battle!


[b]Rules of Duel[/b]

Each turn, six words are given to each magical girl. Each magical girl should try to pick a word which would make the other magical girl have lower chance of chanting with sincerity.

In local mode, use the controls to select the desired word. 
In online mode, click the desired word with your mouse to proceed.

Once you see the completed magic spell, get ready to chant!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/c11991be18c3d2167cec4d1fb6347715f6c99dff.jpg[/img]

[b]Recite the magic spell[/b]

In local mode, reciting should be done by taking turns with the same microphone. 
In online mode, chant the spell according to the count, at the same time.

Each turn, the losing magical girl in the judgment takes mental damage. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/beaf93765bd41eb926e8ea3d68cb2792cd5aef87.jpg[/img]

The magical girl who depletes the opponent's mental strength wins!



<Training Tips from the Magical Agency>

The key is sincerity! But to win a duel, sincerity alone might not be enough.

Word Selection: Choose words that are hard to pronounce or likely to cause laughter for your opponent.
Sentence Display: Read the sentence in advance before chanting! Reading in real-time might cause pronunciation errors.
Reading Sentences Correctly: Speak more clearly than your opponent!
Try Using Various Tones - Every magical girl has a tone that suits the magical girl! Practice and experiment with different tones!

notes.title: Grand Magical Bureau Report Episode 2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Grand Magical Bureau Report: Episode 2[/b][/h1]


The Grand Magical Bureau proudly presents the second installment of our series. This time, we delve into the legendary tale of the magical girl, Jumrye.


[h3][b]The Legendary Magical Girl[/b][/h3]


Born in 1933, Jumrye had a challenging childhood. It was only after the liberation, amid the overflowing joy, that she discovered her magical abilities and embarked on her journey as a magical girl. Initially, she was just an ordinary magical girl, but a chance event led her to realize her immense magical potential. Her awakening occurred shortly after the outbreak of the Korean War, triggered by the conscription of her beloved, Kim Chumji. Deeply distressed, Jumrye cast a powerful protective spell with all her heart, successfully performing a grand protection magic that only 0.01% of magical girls can achieve. As a result, Kim Chumji survived numerous life-threatening situations and returned home safely.

During the war, Jumrye's active participation as a magical girl brought hope to many. However, the dire times meant she was constantly overworked, and her seemingly endless magical energy began to deplete. Despite this, her extraordinary powers forced her to continue her efforts. After the war, she aimed for a peaceful life with Kim Chumji, contributing significantly to purging the world's evil and striving for justice.



[h3][b]Jumrye's Personality[/b][/h3]


Jumrye was undoubtedly a pure-hearted person untainted by the world. Despite experiencing despair and anger as she learned about the world, she disciplined herself to maintain her pure magical energy by keeping her heart kind and clear. Her gentle smile is the result of endless effort and sacrifice, a testament to her commitment to protecting justice and peace in the absence of a successor. It's difficult for ordinary people to fathom the emotional scars she carries. The weight of responsibility borne by the strongest magical girl is unimaginably heavy, yet Jumrye has endured it all these years.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/3d5e598be5d92c0297e1ab699b492048881ca9f0.png[/img]
<Jumrye in the Early Years>

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/b3915c6309d899ed65bd01fcc432276c1cdd6bbe.png[/img]
<Jumrye Today>

[h3][b]Welfare System for Elderly Magical Girls[/b][/h3]

Recognizing the immense contributions of magical girls to the nation's survival and the improvement of desperate situations, the Grand Magical Bureau offers substantial support to ensure their well-being. Since 2011, the Bureau has provided exemptions from heating costs to counter the common chills experienced by elderly magical girls due to magical depletion. Additionally, we offer a personalized caregiver matching system, magical girl pensions, and other practical assistance programs.


[h3][b]In Conclusion[/b][/h3]


The sacrifices of magical girls often go unnoticed by the general public. To ensure their efforts are not in vain, the Grand Magical Bureau promises to continue its promotional activities and expand welfare policies for retired magical girls.



[i]Regarding the Recent Rampage Incident

We are conducting a thorough investigation into the unfortunate incidents involving Paul. We commend Bujang Kim for his efforts in resolving the situation and promise to uncover the truth through a meticulous inquiry.[/i]

notes.title: Grand Magical Bureau Report Episode 1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Grand Magical Bureau Report: Episode 1[/b][/h1]

In this iconic series, the first installment of the Grand Magical Bureau Report brings you the story of the rising star in the magical girl world, Bujang Kim. Stay tuned for more fascinating stories about various magical girls in the future.

[h3][b]The World of Magical Girls[/b][/h3]

There are many well-known magical girls in the world. From the very first Magical Girl Lalabel, Kiki's Delivery Service, Slayers, Sailor Moon, and more. Their commonality lies in using magic to uphold justice, fighting evil forces, and purifying wicked hearts. However, the production of new magical girls has ceased, and the aging of existing magical girls has become a growing concern for the Chief of Grand Magical Bureau.

Recently, however, changes to the magical girl selection criteria have allowed for the selection of magical girls of various ages and genders, leading to a wave of anticipation. The emergence of an exceptional talent like Bujang Kim has created an incredibly positive atmosphere internally, with high hopes for his future endeavors.


[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2Fda68fd87-4cc3-4486-bc1e-e1000cda9f4b%2FKim_Base.png&blockId=e0df4e99-d2e3-4a28-81b6-fb32ca9a60dc[/img]

[Profile Picture of Bujang Kim]


[h3][b]The Arrival of Bujang Kim[/b][/h3]

Agents from around the world are constantly on the lookout for powerful magical forces. In Seoul, where such forces are abundant, many agents are active, and none could miss the powerful magic emanating from Bujang Kim. The question was who would reach him first, and it was Meow*, the elite cat agent, who acted the fastest. Only those with strong magical abilities can see Meow* in human form, and Bujang Kim recognized Meow*'s human form immediately upon their meeting, thus beginning their fateful connection. Currently, Meow* is actively serving as Bujang Kim’s dedicated agent.


[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2F2819923c-2e12-4d87-ba90-939038d59a18%2Fmontage.png&blockId=dd82ca8c-b346-4b15-af08-3ec05d716808[/img]

[Montage of Bujang Kim at the Time of Selection]


[h3][b]The Personality of Bujang Kim[/b][/h3]

Once Bujang Kim's existence became known, he gained many fans. Here’s a closer look at him. Before becoming a magical girl, Bujang Kim was a diligent and hardworking head of the sales team at ReLU Insurance. However, he felt as if he were wearing clothes that didn’t fit, and his satisfaction with life was low. His pure and bright spirit, unyielding passion, and sense of justice couldn’t be fully expressed in his daily work environment, which likely made his life more challenging without him fully understanding why.

Now, as a magical girl, Bujang Kim feels a great sense of pride in his new identity. His overflowing determination is evident in his strong and confident manner of speaking.


[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2Ffbb76e6c-9e6e-477d-a6e2-971fdf42fb4a%2Foptimized.gif&blockId=edba5124-d48f-48e8-8cb5-ca6a119b87d4[/img]

[First Transformation of Bujang Kim into a Magical Girl]


[h3][b]The Achievements of Bujang Kim[/b][/h3]

Recently, Bujang Kim purified a caretaker who was tainted with evil, and single-handedly subdued the rampage of a grand magical girl, a feat that even a nation’s worth of military power couldn’t achieve. Most astonishingly, all of this was accomplished the day after his awakening as a magical girl. The Grand Magical Bureau has officially declared this incident one of the most remarkable in magical history and registered it as Case No. 3 in the Grand Magical Bureau Archive of Magical History for permanent preservation.

[h3][b]In Conclusion[/b][/h3]

The Grand Magical Bureau foresees boundless achievements from him in the future. They also praised the efforts of agents who discovered such an excellent magical girl soon after the selection criteria changes and expressed reflection on the outdated past.

We look forward to the future activities of new magical girls!

notes.title: Step by Step guide to setting up your Wand (aka Microphone)
notes.content:
Hello, Magical Girls!

To enjoy "Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear My Spell," you need a magic wand (microphone) connected to your PC. Here are the instructions to help you prepare for the game.

[h3][b]First, prepare the magic wand (microphone) and connect it to your PC.
For best experience, it is HIGHLY RECOMMENDED to use directly connected microphone and without sound altering software, a separate audio interface.[/b][/h3]

(The connection method may vary depending on the microphone model and hardware environment, so please refer to the manufacturer’s instructions for your device.)

For Bluetooth devices, connect to the PC’s Bluetooth according to the manufacturer’s connection guide.

First thing to check:
[b]Check if the microphone is connected to the PC. For Windows 10, go to Settings > Privacy > Microphone and ensure 'Allow apps to access the microphone.' For Windows 11, go to Privacy & security > Microphone and make sure 'Microphone access' is turned 'On.' Also, verify that the microphone permissions are granted for the game.
[url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/turn-on-app-permissions-for-your-microphone-in-windows-10-94991183-f69d-b4cf-4679-c98ca45f577a]Microsoft Support[/url][/b]

[h1][b]For Windows 11:[/b][/h1]

Go to Start > Settings > System > Sound

Scroll down to the input section and ensure that the microphone you prepared is set as the input device.

Especially if you have multiple microphone devices like a webcam, make sure the desired device is selected.

[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2Ffa3e550d-90a5-48ac-8f24-8c39ac8166c1%2Fscreenshot_en.png&blockId=fe5db93e-862d-4285-b3c3-4d761699b3cf[/img]

On some versions, you can click on your desired microphone for more specific settings. Click the microphone test button at the bottom, and shout "Shalala, I want to be pretty! Transform into a magical girl" to check if it’s working!


[h1][b]For Windows 10:[/b][/h1]

Goto Windows Settings > System > Sound tab.
[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2Ff6d9185b-a8b2-4bb7-b27a-704ec83be733%2Fscreenshotformic.jpg&blockId=70fab2c5-91be-4908-b208-bfd273009e70[/img]

[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2F5aec5481-7a68-4f5a-a160-8059e662eb35%2Fscreenshotformic2.jpg&blockId=dfc5074e-e384-4b81-918c-0d11c6a7e510[/img]

[b]Check if the desired magic wand (microphone) is selected. [/b]If the device you want to use is not selected, click the drop down or list and pick your desired magic want.

To check if the device is working properly, shout "Shalala, I want to be pretty! Transform into a magical girl" into the magic wand (microphone). Make sure you see a magical wave on the indicator bar on the bottom.

[b](Important) Finally, after starting the game, make sure the magic wand (microphone) is set in the options screen![/b]

[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2F49b0ba88-b6a4-486e-b97a-5bf85928c704%2Fimage-2024-5-16_16-14-17.png&blockId=c818000b-9ab4-43bb-9526-14340e784155[/img]

If you have any other questions, join our Discord server https://discord.gg/ephaKCPeyf!

notes.title: Subject: Official Announcement from GMB
notes.content:
![Grand Magical Bureau (GMB) Official Letterhead]

[b]FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
[/b]
From: The Office of the Chief, Grand Magical Bureau (GMB) HQ
To: The Citizens of the World

Subject: Early Access Announcement - "Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear my Spell" 
Document No.: GMB-PR-2024-0508
Date: May 8, 2024

Greetings, esteemed citizens of the world,

It is with great pleasure that I, the Chief of the Grand Magical Bureau (GMB) HQ, announce the official launch of our revolutionary Magical Girl Voice Role Simulation Software, "Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear my Spell."

[b]Background: [/b]
For decades, magical girls have been the unsung heroes, maintaining order and defending justice globally. 

However, due to the persistent worldwide low birth rate, the magical girl community is facing an unprecedented aging crisis.

To address this issue, the GMB has taken swift action to relax the recruitment conditions for magical girls, previously limited to young girls,

allowing anyone with the resolve to protect the world and the aptitude for magic to join our ranks.

[b]Project Overview: [/b]
"Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear my Spell" is a groundbreaking public project designed to help individuals discover their potential as magical girls and enhance their magical capabilities. It features the inspiring true story of Ms. Kim, head of the ReLU Insurance Company's department and an exemplary active magical girl.

Apologies, for we do not have a fixed date at this moment, but I can say that the game is set to release very soon on Steam Early Access. 

[b]Key Features:[/b]
Immersive voice role-playing experience with a microphone-enabled interface
Scripted, emotionally moving true story of Ms. Kim's early magical girl activities
Insights into the mindset, etiquette, and detailed work of magical girls
Magical skill development and training opportunities
Online and local multiplayer magic battle mode for collaborative spell practice

[b]Recruitment Process: [/b]
GMB recruit agents are actively seeking magical girl candidates worldwide.

Individuals who have honed their magical skills through "Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear my Spell" will be given preferential consideration in the recruitment process.

[b]Acknowledgments: [/b]
The GMB extends its gratitude to ReLU Games for their invaluable contribution to the development of this project.

[b]Call to Action: [/b]
We invite all citizens to join us in our mission to strengthen the magical girl community.
Together, let us fill the world with the resounding echoes of powerful magic spells and support the next generation of magical girls.

Sincerely,

[b](Signature) Chief of the Grand Magical Bureau HQ[/b]

This document is official correspondence from the Grand Magical Bureau HQ and is intended for public dissemination.
